description: riversCentralAsia is an R package from hydrosolutions for preparing and analysing inputs to hydrological models, particularly RS MINERVE. It helps derive hydrological response units and convert meteorological products into model-readable forcing, with additional workflows for snow, glacier and discharge calibration. The documentation was developed around semi-arid Central Asian catchments, although most functions can be applied elsewhere with suitable inputs. A modeller can use these workflows to prepare river inflows for irrigation and reservoir simulations. Geographic and temporal detail follow the chosen elevation and climate products. The source and tutorial links are public on GitHub under GPL-3. A limitation is that the package does not replace basin delineation, the RS MINERVE solver or the calibration observations; these remain separate workflow requirements. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review checked the documented input preparation and licence without obtaining climate grids, installing RS MINERVE or reproducing a case study. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
